interface.signature: def captainAmerica(N: int, M: int, V: List[List[int]]) -> int:

preconditions.description: N is the number of rooms (1 ≤ N ≤ 30000) and M is the number of gates (1 ≤ M ≤ 200000).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= N and 1 <= q <= N for [p, q] in V)
preconditions.description: Each gate in V is a pair of integers (p, q) where p and q are valid room numbers (1 ≤ p, q ≤ N).
The length of V is exactly M, representing the number of gates.

postconditions.expression: return_value == len({room for room in range(1, N + 1) if all(any(has_path(room, x) for x in range(1, N + 1)) for x in range(1, N + 1))})
postconditions.description: The function returns the count of rooms from which every other room in the maze is reachable (directly or indirectly).

invariants.expression: has_path == lambda a, b: any(has_path(a, x) and has_path(x, b) for x in range(1, N + 1)) or a == b or any(a == x[0] and x[1] == b for x in V)
invariants.description: has_path(a, b) is true if there exists a path from room a to room b, either directly or indirectly.

confirmed_issues.instruction: The recursive definition of `has_path` is incorrect. It does not correctly model reachability in a directed graph with cycles (e.g., it will not terminate for cycles and incorrectly assumes transitivity via arbitrary `x`). Replace with a correct reachability definition (e.g., using adjacency list or DFS/BFS semantics).

candidate_issues.instruction: The recursive definition of `has_path` is incorrect. It does not correctly model reachability in a directed graph with cycles (e.g., it will not terminate for cycles and incorrectly assumes transitivity via arbitrary `x`). Replace with a correct reachability definition (e.g., using adjacency list or DFS/BFS semantics).

Add an invariant defining the adjacency list or graph structure (e.g., `adj = {room: [] for room in range(1, N + 1)}; for [p, q] in V: adj[p].append(q)`). The current contract lacks a definition of how gates are represented in the graph.

The postcondition expression is incorrect. It checks for rooms from which *every other room* is reachable, but the task requires rooms that are *reachable from every other room* (i.e., rooms that are in the intersection of all reachable sets from every room). Replace with: `return_value == len({room for room in range(1, N + 1) if all(any(has_path(x, room) for x in range(1, N + 1)) for x in range(1, N + 1))})`
candidate_issues.task_evidence: Captain America is hiding only in those rooms which are accessible directly/indirectly through every other room in the maze.
